2026-11-05PS, EMCREmergency Management ActProvincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 296, YukonProvincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 296 in order to (1) declare the natural disaster to be of concern to the federal government; and (2) authorize the provision of financial assistance to Yukon with respect to the extreme cold wave that occurred in Yukon, in January 2026.N/A
subject: Provincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 296, Yukon
precis: Provincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 296 in order to (1) declare the natural disaster to be of concern to the federal government; and (2) authorize the provision of financial assistance to Yukon with respect to the extreme cold wave that occurred in Yukon, in January 2026.
